# Reviewed items from the weekly models.dev cross-check (.github/scripts/check_models_dev.py).
# One item per line. Lines starting with # are comments; text after " #" is a note.
#   <lab>/<id>                         a new model we reviewed and chose not to add
#   <lab>/<id> release_date=<date>     models.dev's date differs and ours is right
#   <lab>/<id> open_weights=<bool>     models.dev's open-weights flag differs and ours is right
#   match <lab>/<id> = <our name>      our row has a different name from models.dev's file
# A difference line only silences that exact value; if models.dev changes it, it's reported again.
